items.text: Inventory now automatically closes the full loot container UI when you walk away, instead of switching to quick craft.
Crabs now use proper LOD and physics settings.
Crabs are excluded from player collision layers, so they no longer push or move players.

Throwable prediction has been fixed, improving the accuracy of grenades and other thrown items.
Fixed beancan throw visual prediction and corrected molotov hit effects and breaking behavior, ensuring proper gibs and fireball spawn.
Fixed aiming inaccuracy when using turn-in-place, improving shot precision while rotating.
Corrected rounding errors on vendor auction HQM ore listings, fixing price calculations.

Fixed spine alignment when aiming down sights, eliminating the hunched‑over posture and improving aiming feel.

items.text: Adjusted swimming depth thresholds to start at 1.17 m and stop below 0.9 m, reducing animation dithering and slightly delaying exit from shallow water.
Car lifts now refuse to grab a car if any animals are mounted on it.
Fixed dismount action to properly remove the stir bar, preventing leftover objects after exiting.

Wool can be recycled into 5 cloth pieces; adult cows/sheep lifespan doubled to 48 h; livestock feeding now uses food calories (high‑calorie foods 6× more effective, low‑calorie less) and prevents eating spoiled produce; ranch sales now give 30‑50 high‑quality metal ore instead of HQM.
Milk products now provide double calories and triple hydration; beef and rich beef pies last 120 min (up from 30 min); mutton pie renamed to shepherd's pie and now requires a potato.
Spiral staircases now decay and count toward TC upkeep; added server‑population‑scaled settings for power‑plant heavy fuse decay rate.
Helipad repair now requires 30,000 wood, 10,000 metal fragments, and 100 rope, and added AIRWOLF CCTV (S2P).

Fixed armored triangle ladder hatch collision meshes, biofuel generator flag collision, and prevented composters from becoming bricked when splashed by water, restoring proper placement and functionality.
Improved client‑side prediction for thrown projectiles, reconciling position and velocity with server data and handling stick events reliably.
Machete network range reduced from medium to low, decreasing its effective reach in multiplayer.
Grenade drop animation now synchronized with throw release, ensuring grenades spawn at the intended moment.
Fish hitboxes corrected and death animation loops fixed, improving combat accuracy with critter animals.
Added ferry terminal and radtown locations.
Crate in Radtown moved and window sign replaced with a two‑sided variant to stop looting through the window gap.
Reapplied the NMS loot room after file conflicts, restoring its availability.
Shields and diving tanks now appear correctly in the backpack slot of the loadout screen.
Animals can no longer slip through doors at monuments, preventing unintended entry and protecting bases.

2026-09-23.summary:
### Movement & Swimming
- Adjusted swimming depth thresholds to start at 1.17 m and stop below 0.9 m, reducing animation dithering and slightly delaying exit from shallow water.

### Vehicles & Tools
- Car lifts now refuse to grab a car if any animals are mounted on it.
- Fixed dismount action to properly remove the stir bar, preventing leftover objects after exiting.

### Livestock, Ranching & Food
- Wool can be recycled into 5 cloth pieces; adult cows/sheep lifespan doubled to 48 h; livestock feeding now uses food calories (high‑calorie foods 6× more effective, low‑calorie less) and prevents eating spoiled produce; ranch sales now give 30‑50 high‑quality metal ore instead of HQM.
- Milk products now provide double calories and triple hydration; beef and rich beef pies last 120 min (up from 30 min); mutton pie renamed to shepherd's pie and now requires a potato.

### Base Upkeep & Building
- Spiral staircases now decay and count toward TC upkeep; added server‑population‑scaled settings for power‑plant heavy fuse decay rate.
- Helipad repair now requires 30,000 wood, 10,000 metal fragments, and 100 rope, and added AIRWOLF CCTV (S2P).
- Fixed armored triangle ladder hatch collision meshes, biofuel generator flag collision, and prevented composters from becoming bricked when splashed by water, restoring proper placement and functionality.

### Combat & Weapons
- Improved client‑side prediction for thrown projectiles, reconciling position and velocity with server data and handling stick events reliably.
- Machete network range reduced from medium to low, decreasing its effective reach in multiplayer.
- Grenade drop animation now synchronized with throw release, ensuring grenades spawn at the intended moment.
- Fish hitboxes corrected and death animation loops fixed, improving combat accuracy with critter animals.

### World, Map & Exploits
- Added ferry terminal and radtown locations.
- Crate in Radtown moved and window sign replaced with a two‑sided variant to stop looting through the window gap.
- Reapplied the NMS loot room after file conflicts, restoring its availability.

### Inventory & UI
- Shields and diving tanks now appear correctly in the backpack slot of the loadout screen.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Animals can no longer slip through doors at monuments, preventing unintended entry and protecting bases.

items.text: Doubled dung production speed for cows and sheep; fixed horse dung bug and set horse dung per calorie to 0.2.
Harvest yields increased: cows now give 30 cloth, 100 leather, 100 bones, 20 beef, 40 fat; sheep now give 10 cloth, 20 leather, 50 bones, 12 mutton, 20 fat plus any wool they have.
Livestock sales charts reworked with a random reward pool (turrets, HQM, rifles, scrap, saddles, rope, blue cards, tarps, CCTV, targeting computers, frags); wool chart updated accordingly.
Animals automatically dismount when their vehicle rolls over or submerges; white sheep are now the beneficial gene variant; groundwatch collider layer issue fixed.
Fixed deep‑sea boat transfer bug that left players behind near walls; introduced jellyfish swarms as a new critter group.
Adjusted power phase requirements, tweaked loot spawn types, corrected harbor_1 topology, and updated helipad repair requirements.
Biofuel generator added with description, crafting costs, tech‑tree entry, and corrected deployment orientation; related tech‑tree fixes applied.
Added new ferry terminal, radtown, and oil rig structures.
Waterwheel melee protection increased by 4–5×.
Oil rigs no longer emit radiation while the locked crate is untouched; crate hacked state persists after server restarts; chicken eggs now drop flush with terrain and avoid physics glitches.
Fixed fire arrows sticking to the third‑person bow for other players.
Prisoner hood now muffles voice while keeping chat clear.
Pool cue visual quality now stays consistent in first‑person when swapping between different cues.
Cows no longer incorrectly receive crocodile protection, fixing unintended protection behavior.
Base interiors now correctly collapse to a single outside, preventing interior rooms from being flagged as exterior.
Single‑door controllers retain proper orientation after reskin; doors no longer rotate 90°.
Loadout UI now correctly positions items in their icon slots.
Crystal AK store page displays correct takeover data, fixing purchase display issues.
Store refresh fully restarts the current tab, ensuring tile listings update properly.
Store overlay images support distinct configurations per URL, fixing incorrect mipmap usage on shared URLs.
Store item overlay page refcounting fixed, preventing crashes or visual glitches when opening and closing overlays.
Bundle purchases now correctly list all items in LastBoughtItems and show proper notifications.
HttpImage texture cache only clears when unused, preventing sprites from disappearing during interactions.
Vending machine UI font size standardized, fixing inconsistent text sizing.
